guard.note: init: the title screen is shown (first time = the warm-up starts)
handleLogin: ensureRunningOnSameThread first, then the client level is created (the join)

client_class_warmup.conversion: @Inject RETURN of TitleScreen.init (warm-up thread once per launch + JFR class-define recorder), @Inject RETURN of ClientPacketListener.handleLogin (join: 3-minute recorded window, warm-up limit join + 10 s), @Inject HEAD of Minecraft.clearLevel(Screen) (leave: window closes, warm-up stops); helpers bons.furious.patch.client_class_warmup.ClassWarmup (list file, fingerprint, warm-up: Class.forName(name, false, gameLoader) + getDeclaredConstructors) and ClassDefineRecorder (jdk.jfr RecordingStream, jdk.ClassDefine only); require = 0
